title: Pollinations generation arrives in Claude Code
summary:
A community-heavy day: terminal-native generation, new creative and learning apps, plus sturdier image and music APIs.

A community-built Claude Code CLI plugin now brings image, text, audio, and video generation directly into the terminal. The shell has gained another suspiciously capable command.

The community showcase added InfiniteMud, a persistent procedurally generated world; HyperRush AI for turning scripts and media into polished short-form clips; and a Gemini-powered Twitch chatbot for interactive livestream chats.

New showcase entries include Benchside for biomedical research, Physics study with AI for worked explanations, two image generators, JournalGen, and an all-in-one interface for Pollinations image, audio, and text generation.
